title: Devotion
paragraphs: “Naofumi-san has it tough.”
“He’s basically a babysitter.”
“Don’t act like it’s not your problem. Why don’t you and Ren try taking care of a Filolial?”
Come to think of it, there are quite a few Filolials staying behind. For security reasons, they’re now stationed in various countries.
“Hmm, I don’t really like being in a group.”
“Stop trying to act cool. And why do you look a little embarrassed?”
“I’ll leave it to Motoyasu-san and Naofumi-san. I’ll just borrow one when I need to.”
“Depending on others like that isn’t good… haah.”
Ren and Itsuki looked away, trying to dodge Father’s sigh. That’s right. Ren and Itsuki don’t appreciate how wonderful Filolials are. As we were talking, we arrived at a large tavern.
“This is the tavern that the breeder recommended. Apparently, both the food and drinks are great. They have a wide variety, and it’s a favorite among mercenaries too.”
“Hmm…”
“Well, let’s go in and check it out.”
“Yeah.”
So, we went inside and enjoyed ordering whatever we liked. The breeder was right—everything was quite delicious.
“The local specialty dishes are pretty good too.”
“Indeed, just as Iwatani-dono said, the local sake is quite well-stocked.”
Since Éclair is an adult, she was sipping her drink leisurely. Plenty of food was served, enough to satisfy even the Filolials.
“YAHHAA!”
The tavern was lively with mercenaries making a ruckus. But what does that phrase even mean?
“Are they mercenaries? Or maybe adventurers?”
“Probably. I heard that the Adventurer’s Guild holds a lot of power in this country, right?”
“Seems like it. I took a quick look, and they seem to have all kinds of jobs. As long as you have the skills, this country might be a pretty comfortable place to live.”
“But the security is bad, so we have to be careful. It feels like danger is just lurking around every corner in the back alleys.”
“I’ll strike them down!”
When I gripped my spear, Father and the others gave me slightly awkward looks. It’s the fault of the foolish thieves who dare to attack us.
“Well, they’d be bringing it upon themselves in that case.”
“Though, I’m not sure it’s worth killing over.”
“Still, this is the kind of country where finding corpses in back alleys is common, so even the Heroes should stay cautious.”
What is he saying to us heroes? With our current strength, this would be a walk in the park.
“Speaking of mercenaries… maybe it’s about time we start raising allies other than Filolials?”
“Hmm… like the kingdom’s soldiers?”
“That would be a reasonable choice. If the Heroes take the lead in training soldiers… wasn’t there a plan to boost the levels of some soldiers back during the Nosferatu Great Forest incident?”
“Oh yeah, I think that came up.”
“But… after being betrayed by allies within just a few days, I’m honestly a bit reluctant to recruit more.”
Ren answered with a bitter expression. Quite some time has passed since this loop started, but it seems the trauma still lingers.
“Yeah. In my case, from what I’ve heard from Motoyasu-san, I was killed or almost killed by my companions many times…”
“Hmm. Trustworthy companions… maybe it’s best to follow Father’s suggestion and stick to people Motoyasu-kun knew, like Eclair?”
At Father’s words, Ren and Itsuki turned their eyes toward me.
“Motoyasu-san, including the first world, what kind of companions did we have? Were there any trustworthy ones?”

Itsuki leaned forward and asked me. That’s right. I remember that all of Itsuki’s companions committed crimes and were executed. The only exception was Stalker Pig. But since they’re asking me to include the first set of companions, I’ll answer honestly.
“Itsuki, is it? In my memory, aside from Smoked Meat and his followers, the only companion you had was Stalker Pig. She stayed with you the whole time in Father’s village.”
“Stalker!?”
“Was she being held captive? No, wait… is this about the first world where Naofumi was managing the territory? So, Naofumi’s companion ended up taking care of Itsuki?”
I can still remember it vividly. The sight of Itsuki and Stalker Pig sticking together all the time. Well, Itsuki was acting a little strange back then.

“Even in the previous loop, I think Itsuki brought her along. But I believe she was taken back home because of her bad reputation. After that, the Four Guardian Spirits were revived, so I’m not sure what happened after that.”
“Hmm…”
“So, a stalker was taking care of me? That’s a complete victory for the stalker, isn’t it…”
Itsuki slumped down in shock. I understand how he feels… After all, I came to this world because of that selfish pig.
“Well, among the pigs, she was quite capable. She contributed enough as one of Father’s subordinates.”
“She was supposed to be my companion, but she ended up becoming Naofumi-san’s ally?”
“I talked to her before I awakened to love. It’s not an important story, but I remember a little of it.”

I explained Stalker Pig’s situation to Itsuki. Apparently, Itsuki had saved her from a desperate situation, and she admired Itsuki’s sense of justice, which led her to become Itsuki’s companion. However, because her stats were inferior, she was reduced to doing errands and was eventually abandoned. Even then, she couldn’t give up and resorted to stalking. I was so scared of Stalker Pig’s persistence that I pushed her onto Father.
“I don’t know what happened after that. But as I mentioned earlier, she was always with Itsuki in the village.”
Itsuki suddenly fell silent.
“Motoyasu-kun’s explanation is so bad that it’s hard to understand… but maybe that person had a lot of feelings for Itsuki?”

“Well, this is second-hand information, but I heard from the Filolials that it was Stalker Pig who stopped Itsuki when he was consumed by the curse, believing that the opposite of justice is also justice.”
“So, to sum it up, she was cruelly abandoned by the Itsuki she trusted, ended up being taken in by Naofumi, stopped Itsuki when he went berserk, and then diligently took care of him?”
“…Wouldn’t that be called devotion, not stalking?”
“Where can I meet that person!? That’s my destined companion, isn’t it!?”
Itsuki grabbed me by the collar and shook me. What’s this now? Is he really that interested?
“Wait a minute. You mentioned something about being saved from a desperate situation, right…?”
Itsuki is turning paler and paler.
“I don’t want to say this, but… maybe you should give up.”
“No way! It sounds like this person is my destined one!”
“So, Itsuki is interested in that kind of thing after all.”
“Motoyasu-san, please remember! Where did I meet this person, and what’s their name?”
Itsuki pressed me for answers with a serious look.
“May I ask as well, Kitamura-dono?”
Éclair backed him up. Why is Éclair getting involved?
“Ah… if I recall correctly, Motoyasu-kun mentioned that Eclair-san died in prison and that her funeral was held around this time in the previous loop…”
“Hmm, perhaps that person is also in need of help. If that’s the case, we should act immediately.”
“You’re right. Motoyasu-kun, I’m asking you too. Do you remember the name of that person?”
“Well, let’s see…”

What was the name again? I retraced the words I had spoken back when I was still chasing after pigs before awakening to love… Ah, I remember it now. It was something I said when I was soaking in the hot springs with Father and the others on Cal Mira Island.
I remember talking about a beauty ranking. The Crimson Swine, the older sister, and Filo-tan were all nominated. And Stalker Pig was the runner-up.
“Ah, I remember now. I think her name was Rishia.”
“Rishia… san.”
Itsuki repeated the name softly. That should be correct.
“But isn’t it going to be difficult to narrow it down with just the name Rishia?”

“Motoyasu-kun mentioned earlier that she was taken back to her family home, right? That means she’s probably from a good family. Depending on what kind of danger she was in, we might be able to narrow it down.”
“I see. With that information, we can start moving. We should search immediately. It might already be too late!”
“Yeah. Since Itsuki gathered his companions in Melromarc, that girl is probably in Melromarc too. Why don’t you ask the Queen about it tomorrow?”
“…No, I’ll leave right away.”
“Will Kou run?”
Kou, who had been quietly eating his meal, spoke up to Itsuki. Oh, is he going to help search for Stalker Pig?
“Kou-san, can I ask for your help?”
“Leave it to me.”
Kou nodded in response to Itsuki’s request. Kou… he’s become such a good boy… At this rate, I doubt anyone would complain if he took a bite out of Itsuki’s hair.
